If you're in **Spotswood, VIC**, there are several locksmiths that install smart locks as well as traditional locks.

Here are some good options:

- Precision Locksmiths Melbourne (Spotswood) – Highly rated local locksmith offering smart lock installation, lock replacement, and emergency services.
- SMART LOCK INSTALLATION – Melbourne specialist focused exclusively on digital and smart locks. They install a wide range of brands including Yale, Lockwood, Aqara, Eufy, Schlage, Samsung, Philips, Bosch, and Kaadas. They service Melbourne, including the western suburbs. [www.smartlockinstallation.com.au](https://www.smartlockinstallation.com.au/home?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Lock, Smith and Barrel (West Footscray) – Nearby emergency locksmith with experience installing digital locks.
- Port Melbourne Locksmiths – Offers residential smart lock installation across Melbourne's inner west.
- Blackshaws Locksmith (Altona North) – Local locksmith servicing the Spotswood area with lock upgrades and installations.

If you've already bought a smart lock (for example from Bunnings or another retailer), installation typically costs around **A$150–A$300** for a straightforward replacement. More complex installations that require door modifications or mortise changes can cost more. [www.smartlockwarehouse.com.au](https://www.smartlockwarehouse.com.au/products/smart-lock-installation-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you haven't chosen a lock yet, tell me:
- your **door type** (timber, aluminium, security screen, apartment, etc.), and
- whether you want **keypad only**, **fingerprint**, **Apple Home/HomeKit**, **Google Home**, or **Matter** support,

and I can recommend a compatible smart lock and an installer.
